name: DATETIMEOFFSET retains original offset
source_basis: Original +05:30 offset must remain recoverable; UTC instant alone is insufficient. Text round-trip is a diagnostic for this candidate, not a universal representation test.

name: SMALLDATETIME rounds seconds 29
source_basis: Source assignment rounds to the nearest minute; valid input must not simply be rejected.

name: SMALLDATETIME rounds seconds 30
source_basis: Source assignment rounds to the nearest minute; valid input must not simply be rejected.

name: DATETIME rounds .001 to tick zero
source_basis: Legacy DATETIME rounds .001 seconds to .000; stored tick behavior remains broader than this example.

name: BINARY(16) pads a short binary input
source_basis: Binary-to-binary conversion pads on the right with zero bytes.

name: VARCHAR comparison ignores trailing spaces
source_basis: SQL Server pads strings for equality comparison, independently of ANSI_PADDING storage settings.
sql: INSERT INTO "Companies"(code,name) VALUES ('GAP','Gap'); SELECT code='GAP ' FROM "Companies" WHERE code='GAP';

name: NVARCHAR UTF16 supplementary boundary control
source_basis: Under an SC source collation, 2000 supplementary characters occupy 4000 UTF-16 units. This control does not establish the unknown source collation.

name: NVARCHAR UTF16 supplementary overflow control
source_basis: Under an SC source collation, 2001 supplementary characters exceed NVARCHAR(4000); retain the existing UTF-16 unit guard.
sql: CREATE FUNCTION pg_temp.rejects(q text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN EXECUTE q; RETURN false; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RETURN SQLSTATE IN ('22001','23514'); END $$; SELECT pg_temp.rejects($probe$INSERT INTO "TypeSmoke"(s_min,dt2_p0,n_inline_max) VALUES ('X','2025-01-01',repeat(chr(128512),2001))$probe$);
